description: The line plot illustrates how the performance of four different resource types—Tutorials, Library Documentation, StackOverflow posts, and Github files—varies as the number of tokens increases from 200 to 1000. The x-axis, labeled “Number of Tokens,” uses a linear scale with tick marks at 200, 400, 600, 800, and 1000. The y-axis, representing performance without specified units, is also linearly scaled from 10 to 40, with major ticks every 10 units. The blue line for “Tutorials” starts at approximately 23 at 200 tokens and rises steadily to about 29 at 800 tokens, then plateaus slightly near 29 at 1000 tokens. The red line for “Library Documentation” begins at roughly 26 at 200 tokens, climbs to a peak of about 30 at 500 tokens, then declines to approximately 27 at 800 tokens and further to 25 at 1000 tokens. The yellow line for “StackOverflow posts” starts high at 33 at 200 tokens and decreases sharply, reaching 19 at 800 tokens and dropping to 12 at 1000 tokens. The green line for “Github files” begins at 28 at 200 tokens, rises gradually to 33 at 800 tokens, and remains stable at 33 at 1000 tokens. The yellow and green lines intersect near 600 tokens, where both are at approximately 25. A legend at the top identifies each line by color and label.
caption_used: The line plot illustrates the performance of different resources as the number of tokens increases. The x-axis is labeled 'Number of Tokens' and follows a linear scale ranging from 200 to 1000, with tick marks at intervals of 200 units. The y-axis represents performance, though specific units are not indicated, and it appears linearly scaled and ranges from 10 to 40, with tick marks at intervals of 10 units. The blue line representing 'Tutorials' begins at approximately 23 when x = 200 and increases steadily to around 35 at x = 800, showing consistent improvement. The red line for 'Library Documentation' starts at about 28 when x = 200, peaks at approximately 35 at x = 500, and then declines sharply to around 25 at x = 800. The yellow line for 'StackOverflow posts' begins at a height of 32 and decreases steadily to about 15 by x = 1000, showing a significant drop. Finally, the green line for 'Github files' starts at 29 and rises smoothly to around 33 at x = 800, then stabilizes at approximately 33 by x = 1000. The yellow line and green line intersect at an x value of approximately 600. A legend is available at the top of the plot to infer different lines by their styles.
